text:
emma_support: customer-reported: tenant 6123 missing hourly usage for 03/12 02:00-05:00 window. says console shows zeros, API calls return 200 but metrics not appearing :frowning:

sre_josh: noted. any alerts from ingest?

ingest-bot: ALERT: kafka-consumer tenant-6123 lag spike at 2024-03-12T02:10Z -> consumer_retries=843, error=EOF on partition 12

data_ops_rita: saw a backlog around 02:05 due to a transient broker leader flip. we retried, but backfill job started at 02:30 and then stalled.

emma_support: customer says they triggered a manual backfill at ~02:40 via console. they expect rows by 03:10. nothing showed up.

eng_oncall_lee: quick checks: k8s backfill job pod restarted twice (OOMKilled) at 02:47 and 03:02; logs show a protective "replay-throttle kill switch" engaged when retry rate > 500/s.

data_ops_rita: paste of the relevant log snippet:
```
2024-03-12T02:47:13Z backfill-runner[pid=84] WARN Too many replays, enabling replay-throttle kill-switch
2024-03-12T02:47:13Z backfill-runner[pid=84] INFO Pausing consumer commit loop
2024-03-12T02:47:13Z backfill-runner[pid=84] ERROR OOMKilled while holding in-memory window buffers
```

emma_support: so the job died holding partial prefix caches, kill-switch prevented auto-retry? customer thinks console triggered a second manual replay at 02:55. that might have fed into the same unhealthy controller.

eng_oncall_lee: looks that way. the kill-switch is global per-cluster for safety; when it flips we stop processing replays until manual reset to avoid cascading resource exhaustion. seems we didn't notify on the console that the cluster-level flag was tripped.

product-maya: UX gap then — customers see "backfill scheduled" but not cluster-level kill state. can we log a visible banner?

data_ops_rita: immediate remediation: 1) clear the kill-switch flag 2) reschedule the backfill as a fresh job (new job id) 3) increase pod memory for replay-runner temporarily to avoid OOM during catch-up.

emma_support: can someone run the steps and confirm expected window will appear? customer is on the line. :eyes:

sre_josh: I'm on it. resetting flag now.

ingest-bot: ACTION: replay-throttle kill-switch cleared by user sre_josh at 2024-03-12T03:10:04Z

data_ops_rita: requeued a fresh backfill job id=bf-20240312-6123-2 at 03:11 and bumped memory to 6Gi for that pod.

eng_oncall_lee: watching consumer lag and commit rates. tailing backfill logs...

debug snippet from new job:
```
2024-03-12T03:11:32Z backfill-runner[bf-20240312-6123-2] INFO started reprocessing offsets 120000-121234
2024-03-12T03:12:05Z backfill-runner INFO streaming 1000 events/s
2024-03-12T03:15:44Z backfill-runner INFO commit ok; window flush 03:00->04:00 rows=452
```

emma_support: customer reports first rows appearing in console for 03:00 hour at 03:16. partly good.

data_ops_rita: full catch-up estimate: another ~18 minutes to flush 02:00-05:00 complete range given current throughput, assuming no further restarts.

emma_support: relayed ETA to customer. they asked for root cause - want a short summary and repro steps.

eng_oncall_lee: summary for customer:
- root cause: transient Kafka leader flip caused consumer retries and a high replay rate. the backfill runner hit memory limits while paused by the cluster-level "replay-throttle" kill-switch, which prevented automatic retries and left the job in a stalled state.
- fix applied: kill-switch manually cleared, backfill requeued as a new job with increased memory, system processed backlog and restored hourly rows.
- why it looked like API returns 200 but no metrics: API ingestion path accepted events but the post-ingest backfill processor (rollup window writer) had not completed window flushes until after reprocessing.

data_ops_rita: repro steps (internal):
1) simulate broker leader flip for tenant partition 
2) trigger backfill via console for a small range
3) artificially limit backfill-runner to 2Gi memory -> cause OOM on buffer growth
4) confirm kill-switch flips when retry rate > threshold and backfill stops committing
5) clear kill-switch and requeue to observe recovery

product-maya: can we add a conspicuous console warning when cluster kill-switch is active and expose a "requeue as fresh job" button? file a ticket?

emma_support: filed support ticket SUP-13421 linking logs and timeline and customer message.

eng_oncall_lee: followups for eng: (1) change kill-switch to emit a console notification via control-plane events (2) make backfill-runner more memory resilient (streaming flush earlier) (3) consider a per-tenant kill-switch rather than cluster-global to reduce blast radius.

data_ops_rita: I'll run a short post-mortem and include the exact Kafka offsets affected, and schedule a controlled chaos test for leader flip + backfill.

emma_support: customer happy with ETA and that rows are returning. will close when all hours show populated. :white_check_mark:

sre_josh: monitoring shows 02:00-05:00 fully present by 03:29. marking incident resolved.

emma_support: closing thread; archiving logs to SUP-13421. thx team. :heart:
